children: Hi-Great Group Holding Co reported second-quarter 2026 results showing lower revenue and a reduced net loss versus the year-ago quarter. Revenue for 2Q 2026 was $6.96K, down from $10.14K a year earlier, while net loss improved to $(12.34K) from $(17.04K) in 2Q 2025.
Revenue: $6.96K for 2Q 2026, compared with $10.14K in the year-ago quarter; YoY change (31.4%).
Net income: $(12.34K) for 2Q 2026, compared with $(17.04K) in the year-ago quarter; improvement of $4.71K year over year.
Diluted earnings per share: Not reported for the quarter and therefore omitted.
YTD sales modestly increased to $20.21K, supported by a decline in six-month cost of sales, indicating early-stage commercial traction.
Product strategy shifted away from CBD oils; the company retains exclusive distribution of the SellaCare longevity supplement and is expanding into cosmetics.
Operational costs were reduced, with lower professional and general & administrative expenses driven by decreased audit, accounting and lease costs.
Secured exclusive global licensing focused on KRAS-related opportunities targeting oncology as part of longer-term strategic R&D and licensing efforts.
